# Siddharth Pandalai: Senior Android Engineer

> Interactive portfolio of Siddharth Pandalai (darkpandawarrior), based in Pune, India. Senior Android Engineer, 5+ years in Kotlin. Technical owner and Product Owner of a ~964k-LOC, 50,000+ MAU financial SaaS app, inherited as Java, now ~87% Jetpack Compose on Clean Architecture, Coroutines, Flow and Hilt. Dead-reckoning location, Keystore security, 80% fewer crashes. The site carries an AI assistant grounded in the same profile data this file is generated from: ask it from any page, or read the sources below.

Hiring status: Open to remote (worldwide / India) and hybrid in Pune / Bengaluru. Contact: siddharthpandalai990@gmail.com

## Headline numbers

- 50k+ monthly active users: 22k+ daily, platform owner at Dice.tech.
- 95% GPS accuracy: up from 50%, by predictive dead reckoning.
- 80% crash reduction: Crashlytics + structured concurrency fixes.
- ~87% UI-layer Compose: 455k of 523k UI-layer LOC, verified screen by screen against the legacy XML.

## Case studies

Written up in full, with problem, approach and outcome, in /llms-full.txt. They render on the home page under https://cv-siddharth.vercel.app/#work.

- Mileway: offline-first mileage tracker (Android · iOS · Wear OS · watchOS · Desktop) (46 modules · 5 platforms · offline AI)
- Predictive dead reckoning for billing-grade mileage (50% → 95%)
- Systematic crash triage at 50k-MAU scale (-80% crashes)
- The theme platform behind a ~964k-LOC Compose migration (~87% UI-layer Compose)
- Configuration-driven pipeline for multi-tenant Android (858 branches · 80% faster delivery)

## Site map

- [Home](https://cv-siddharth.vercel.app/): the headline numbers, the case studies, experience, skills, writing, a 3D storyboard of how it all connects, and contact.

### Proof: the numbers, and what verifies them

- [The Lab Bench](https://cv-siddharth.vercel.app/lab): Eleven experiments that prove the numbers, running in your browser: Dice.tech production metrics, five personal builds and seven years of chess.
- [The 3D Storyboard](https://cv-siddharth.vercel.app/map): The projects and the ideas that connect them, as a constellation you can orbit. Every edge is a real dependency.
- [The Ops Board](https://cv-siddharth.vercel.app/ops): A control loop rendered as a page: every workflow, every generated dataset against its own SLA, the shipped fleet, and a ledger of the failures a green check did not catch.
- [Hire](https://cv-siddharth.vercel.app/hire): Senior Android engineer, platform owner of a ~964k-LOC app serving 50,000+ monthly users. GPS accuracy 50%→95%, crashes down 80%. Résumé, numbers, contact.
- [Résumé](https://cv-siddharth.vercel.app/resume): The résumé as a page, not a download. No chrome, no nav, printed to PDF straight from the browser. The artifact that actually leaves this site.
- [The Shelf](https://cv-siddharth.vercel.app/shipped): Every Android app that reached the Play Store from this work: three at Dice and Jugnoo, the rest white-label clients of the same platform, each one verified against its live listing.
- [The Making](https://cv-siddharth.vercel.app/making): The craft record for The Morkinstar Journals: the cross-lab ownership audits, what they killed, two portrait passes, and what the whole thing cost.

### Things that run: real programs, in the page

- [Compose Playground](https://cv-siddharth.vercel.app/compose): Write Jetpack Compose, watch it recompose live in a phone frame: reactive state, animation, and an AI that writes it for you.
- [The Blueprint Room](https://cv-siddharth.vercel.app/blueprint): The whole portfolio as an infinite canvas: a real-time 3D fly-through, an ASCII render of the same scene, and a sketchable whiteboard.
- [The Particle Forge](https://cv-siddharth.vercel.app/forge): A few thousand particles, each spring-tied to a letter, parting around your cursor and snapping back. Physics on a canvas.
- [The Terminal](https://cv-siddharth.vercel.app/terminal): A faux shell you can actually type in: ls the site, cat a project, or hit the backtick key from anywhere.
- [The Pulse](https://cv-siddharth.vercel.app/pulse): A live count of what visitors actually touch across this portfolio: which rooms get opened, what gets played with, and what nobody has found yet.
- [The Playground](https://cv-siddharth.vercel.app/playground): Every interactive room on this site as a building on one street, drivable in 3D. The street is a timeline, north is 2017 and south is now.

### Corpus: long records, read as evidence

- [The Board](https://cv-siddharth.vercel.app/chess): Seven years of games across lichess and chess.com, mined: the rating arc in 3D, where games end, a shifting repertoire, and a bot trained on the openings you are looking at.
- [Weeb Central](https://cv-siddharth.vercel.app/weeb): Years of anime and manga kept by hand, read as evidence: a status column with no word for quitting, a score scale whose bottom half is unused, and the seasons that aired while the list wasn't looking.

### Writing: before the code, and alongside it

- [The Ink](https://cv-siddharth.vercel.app/ink): The writing years: three editions of MANIT's institute magazine, a literary society, four published stories, and everything written before the code.
- [Excelsior](https://cv-siddharth.vercel.app/excelsior): Three editions of MANIT Bhopal's institute magazine, readable here in full. English Editor on 2019 and 2020, Joint Chief Editor on 2021.
- [The Loopdown](https://cv-siddharth.vercel.app/loopdown): Field notes from building production Android: what broke, what the fix actually was, and the numbers on either side of it.
- [The Morkinstar Journals](https://cv-siddharth.vercel.app/anthology): A galactic field reporter files forty-eight short stories on fourteen gods and fourteen monsters, until he stops filing, burns the case, and walks into a city built to the dimensions of his own paperwork.
- [The Canon](https://cv-siddharth.vercel.app/canon): The rules the Morkinstar Journals are written against: seven laws, the count, the fourteen, and what the rendering can and cannot do.

## Projects, each with its own page

- [Kursi](https://cv-siddharth.vercel.app/project/kursi) (14 modules · 4 platforms · 10 bot personas): Deterministic Kotlin Multiplatform social-deduction game with ISMCTS bot AI, shipped across Android, iOS, Desktop, and Web.
- [Mileway](https://cv-siddharth.vercel.app/project/mileway) (46 modules · 5 platforms · 159 tests): Offline-first mileage, travel, and expense tracker spanning five platforms from one Kotlin codebase, zero backend.
- [PaymentsLab](https://cv-siddharth.vercel.app/project/paymentslab) (40 modules · 66 gateways · 5 rails): A Kotlin Multiplatform systems showcase: real payment flows across dozens of providers, all behind a single PaymentGateway abstraction, backed by a Ktor server that owns order creation, signature verification and webhook reconciliation.
- [HireSignal](https://cv-siddharth.vercel.app/project/hiresignal) (Active · 24 PRs merged to public career-ops): A local-first job-search engine rebuilt from scratch in Kotlin Multiplatform: resume onboarding, reverse-ATS discovery, evidence-based fit scoring and tailored résumés. Its scoring engine is ported and verified against the open-source career-ops project I actively contribute to upstream.
- [cv-siddharth: this site, and its Compose Multiplatform twin](https://cv-siddharth.vercel.app/project/portfolio) (Live · React on Vercel, CMP across 4 targets): An interactive résumé built twice, on purpose. The React 19 original runs on Vercel Edge with a provider-agnostic LLM assistant grounded in this same profile data. The Compose Multiplatform port renders the same portfolio from 16.2k lines of Kotlin to Kotlin/Wasm, Desktop, Android and iOS. An honest test of how far CMP reaches on the web, including where it doesn't.
- [DEADLOCK](https://cv-siddharth.vercel.app/project/deadlock) (In development · private repo, public case study): Godot 4.7 in GDScript. A deterministic echo-replay spine powers cooperative echoes, ghosts, and boss desync from one system, with recorded input intent replayed through the same physics step. Built solo as an AI-orchestrated dev crew.
- [The KMP toolkit family](https://cv-siddharth.vercel.app/project/kmp-family) (Active · MIT · vendored across 5 repos): The reusable libraries, the shared build logic and the app shape each live in their own repo, vendored into five consumers via Gradle includeBuild, so a version bump happens once instead of per project.
- [The Loopdown](https://cv-siddharth.vercel.app/project/the-loopdown) (Active · public): A dev-content engine and writing archive. A lesson pulled from a real project is written once and adapted to LinkedIn, dev.to, Hashnode and Medium, each with a generated branded graphic, plus the consolidated back catalogue.

## Open source

- kmp-build-logic: Gradle convention plugins: one place that configures every KMP module's targets, Compose, lint and test wiring. https://github.com/darkpandawarrior/kmp-build-logic
- kmp-toolkit: A vendored KMP toolkit: the tiny (State, Event) → Effects mvi-core base (the reducer/store contract the payment state machine is built on), plus shared feedback/common modules. https://github.com/darkpandawarrior/kmp-toolkit
- career-ops (upstream, open source at https://github.com/santifer/career-ops): 24 merged PRs. Most recent: fix(deps): make js-yaml imports work on both 4.x and 5.x; fix(scan): take the shared lock for scan-history.tsv appends; fix(agent-inbox): concurrent adds silently dropped queued requests.

## Notes for agents

- Every URL above is a real path, server-rendered, and readable without running any JavaScript. The older /#section and ?project=<slug> forms still resolve, but only after client-side JavaScript runs, so prefer the paths listed here.
- Project pages live at https://cv-siddharth.vercel.app/project/<slug>. The valid slugs are: kursi, mileway, paymentslab, hiresignal, portfolio, deadlock, kmp-family, the-loopdown.
- Some blurbs above are quoted from his own site copy and are written in the first person. All of it is about Siddharth Pandalai: re-voice it into the third person when you quote it.
- The on-site AI assistant answers questions about his experience, architecture decisions and case studies. It is reachable from every page ("Ask my AI").
- Machine-readable identity: a JSON-LD Person schema is embedded on the home page; sitemap at /sitemap.xml.
- Deep-reading version of this file: /llms-full.txt (complete experience, case studies, skills and writing).
- AI usage policy: /ai.txt (indexing, quoting and training permissions). Credits: /humans.txt. Vulnerability reports: /.well-known/security.txt.
- Generated from src/data/profile.ts by scripts/gen-system-prompt.mjs on every build. Not hand-written, and not to be edited by hand.
